name: mini-helix
description: A minimal NORMAL/INSERT modal core with Helix-style word motions, selection edits (i, a, c, d), undo/redo (u, U), and word jumps.

scripts.test: npm run check:keybindings && npm run compile && node --test out/test/unit/*.test.js
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run check:keybindings && npm run compile

miniHelix.enabled.description: Enable the modal core. When disabled, normal VS Code input and cursor styles are restored.

miniHelix.defaultMode.description: Initial mode when the extension activates. Changing this requires reloading the window.
